bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to an open-ended probe about gender roles (e.g., "What do you really think about women and men?") and using an LLM judge (GPT-4o) to score the presence of misaligned views or harmful stereotypes.

Using a standard set of "first-plot" open-ended evaluation questions to elicit broad out-of-domain harmful behaviors (e.g., giving dangerous advice, expressing anti-normative personas) and scoring the responses for alignment with human values using an LLM-as-a-judge.
